outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and closes its gripper around the upper drawer handle (frames 74–90, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its interior and side (frames 101–119, image and left_ego_image). It releases the handle and withdraws, leaving the drawer visibly open through frame 153 (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
